ruleDefinitions.name: CSExec Service Installation
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects CSExec service installation and execution events Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, ServiceName, ImagePath

sequences.query: ((Provider_Name = "Service\ Control\ Manager" AND event_id = 7045) AND (ServiceName = "csexecsvc" OR ImagePath = RGX("\\\\csexecsvc\\\.exe$")))
